title: Childhood UFO and nasal brain implant at age five
summary: Steve Coburn tells of Childhood UFO and nasal brain implant at age five, about childhood (age five) at Oxnard, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh I remember having experience at age five where um I think that's when they put the brain implant in

plain: A man named Steve Coburn told podcast host Jesse Michels, on an episode about a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, about an experience at age five in Oxnard, California. He says that he believes that is when "they" placed an implant in his brain through his nose, which, if true, would mean he has carried an alien device since childhood.
